title: earth-moon-alpha2: small-order results on the Earth-Moon problem via independence number 2
description: Research record for the independence-number-2 route of the Earth-Moon problem (chromatic number of biplanar / thickness-2 graphs): proofs of small-order emptiness and structure results (14-18 vertices), SAT non-biplanarity certificates for three C5-inflation candidates and the canonical 18-vertex cone candidate, verification scripts, problem instances, and run logs. Produced by an AI research framework under human direction; not peer-reviewed; every claim carries its verification status in the README.
